pr_title: [Feat] A Connector that supports Mooncake store
source_quote:
The place of docstring in dataclass field is not correct, docstring should under the field, and you miss the docstring of model_name
token_bytes may not be assigned here
it's good to add docstring of field, not just comment.
it's good to add docstring of all dataclass filed.
double check the origin link is correct.
remove this one

rule.description: dataclass 字段的 docstring 必须放在字段定义行的正下方，使用三引号格式，而不是使用行内注释。所有 dataclass 字段都应有 docstring。
checkpoints: dataclass 字段的 docstring 应放在字段下方，使用 `"""..."""` 格式
不要使用 `#` 注释代替 docstring
所有 dataclass 字段都应有 docstring 说明

antipattern.code:
# vllm_ascend/distributed/mooncake/config_data.py
@dataclass
class MooncakeConfig:
    # model_name 缺少 docstring
    model_name: str
    """Some docstring misplaced correctly"""  # ❌ docstring 位置不对
    token_bytes: int = 1024  # 可能不应在此处赋值

pattern.code:
# vllm_ascend/distributed/mooncake/config_data.py
@dataclass
class MooncakeConfig:
    model_name: str
    """The name of the model."""  # ✅ docstring 放在字段下方
    token_bytes: int = 0  # ✅ 修正赋值
    """Number of token bytes."""  # ✅ 所有 dataclass 字段都有 docstring
